title: Resume automatically when a session limit resets
goal: `serve` notices an interrupted coding session and resumes it once after its reset time
acceptance: `serve` records a session that stopped at its usage limit with its reset time and runs the headless resume adapter once after it, with the identity recheck
Restart-survival and once-only tests; needs-attention on change
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18 when the owner approved adding the live binding the owner check needs. Not a measurement.
